summary: Session lap/sector completion handler. Returns immediately when the session is finished (obj+0x32C8 == 3). On the full-lap path (a4 == 0) it records the lap split time into the per-lap timing array, updates best-lap and best-sector state, stores the pit-stop order rank, then dispatches on dword_7C56A4 (retirement, penalty/stop-go processing, disqualification on laps, finish, and last-lap menu transitions), runs a pending-penalty countdown, and writes the common tail (last time, lap time array, phase flag). On the sector path (a4 != 0) it updates per-sector best times and flags. Called by sub_4B3400 and LapSplitTimeEvent (004BC390).
